The tools of the {0} were counted back in at the end of work period {1}: {2} issued, {3} back in, {4} short.{9} Nobody knows where they went, and the count cannot say.

A search of the crew of the period - they are all frisked and the next period starts {8} hour(s) late; what is found is taken, and the room is whole again for each tool.
Carry on short - no time lost, but the room's output is down {5} until the tools are replaced ({6} a tool, from Intel) or found. This is what happens if you do not answer.
